def toggle_middle_bits(n):
    if n == 0:
        return 0 # Edge case, though bit_length is 0 or 1 depending on definition
    
    length = n.bit_length()
    
    # Create a mask with all bits set from 0 to length-1
    full_mask = (1 << length) - 1
    
    # We want to toggle bits strictly between the first (MSB at index length-1) 
    # and last (LSB at index 0).
    # So we create a mask that has 1s only from index 1 to length-2.
    
    # Start with full_mask of ones: e.g., for n=9 (len 4), mask is 1111
    # We need to clear the bit at index 0 and the bit at index length-1
    
    # Clear LSB (index 0)
    mask = full_mask & ~(1 << 0) 
    
    # Clear MSB of our range (which corresponds to original number's MSB position, index length-1)
    msb_pos = length - 1
    mask &= ~(1 << msb_pos)
    
    return n ^ mask

# Test case from prompt
if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert toggle_middle_bits(9) == 15
    print("All tests passed.")
